title: Name the gravity
prompt: 980 is how fast things fall in this game. Name it `GRAVITY` and use the name in the calculation.
signature: func solve(velocity: float, seconds: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(velocity: float, seconds: float) -> float:
	return velocity + 980 * seconds
hint: Declare the constant first, then swap the number for the name. Only the name changes; the maths stays the same.
